mapper.insert: insert into student (id, username, password, name, avatar, role, sex, code, college_id, score, class_id) values (#{id}, #{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{avatar}, #{role}, #{sex}, #{code}, #{collegeId}, #{score}, #{classId})
mapper.update: update student set username = #{username}, password = #{password}, name = #{name}, avatar = #{avatar}, role = #{role},sex=#{sex}, code=#{code}, college_id=#{collegeId}, score=#{score}, class_id=#{classId} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, college.name AS collegeName, IFNULL(s.role, 'STUDENT') AS role FROM student s LEFT JOIN college ON s.college_id = college.id WHERE s.username = #{username}
